## Data Sources for the Data Projects

### Macro (Project 1: measuring development)

- [World Development Indicators](https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-indicators) — the World Bank's flagship cross-country database
- [World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP)](https://pip.worldbank.org/) — international poverty lines and distributional data
- [UNDP Human Development Reports](https://hdr.undp.org/) — HDI, inequality-adjusted HDI, and related indices
- [Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (OPHI)](https://ophi.org.uk/global-mpi/) — the MPI and its components
- [Our World in Data](https://ourworldindata.org/) — long-run series with unusually good documentation of sources and caveats
- [Maddison Project Database](https://www.rug.nl/ggdc/historicaldevelopment/maddison/) — historical GDP per capita estimates
- [V-Dem](https://www.v-dem.net/) — measures of democracy and governance

### Micro (Project 2: the economic lives of the poor)

- [DHS Program](https://dhsprogram.com/) — Demographic and Health Surveys (registration required, free)
- [LSMS](https://www.worldbank.org/en/programs/lsms) — the World Bank's Living Standards Measurement Study household surveys
- [Global Findex](https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/globalfindex) — how adults save, borrow, make payments, and manage risk
- [J-PAL Evaluations](https://www.povertyactionlab.org/evaluations) — randomized evaluations, many with public data
- [IPUMS International](https://international.ipums.org/) — harmonized census microdata

## Development Research and Debate

- [Center for Global Development](https://www.cgdev.org/) — research and blogs at the research–policy interface
- [VoxDev](https://voxdev.org/) — accessible summaries of frontier development economics
- [World Bank Development Impact blog](https://blogs.worldbank.org/en/impactevaluations) — methods-focused, useful for evaluating evidence
- [Trade Talks](https://tradetalkspodcast.com/) and [Ideas of India](https://www.mercatus.org/ideasofindia) — podcasts that regularly cover development topics well

## Writing and Research Help

- [IU Libraries](https://libraries.indiana.edu/) — and the [International Studies research guide](https://guides.libraries.indiana.edu/) for finding scholarship
- [Zotero](https://www.zotero.org/) — free citation management; learn it now, thank yourself at the prospectus stage
- Writing Tutorial Services at [Wells Library](https://wts.indiana.edu/) — free consultations at any stage of drafting
- For policy-memo genre conventions: the [Harvard Kennedy School policy-memo guidance](https://policymemos.hks.harvard.edu/) is a solid model

## Course Logistics

- [Canvas](https://canvas.iu.edu) — readings, submissions, announcements, grades
- [Schedule an appointment](https://bookings.cloud.microsoft/book/ProfBDsOfficeHours@bookings.iu.edu/?ismsaljsauthenabled=true) — office hours via Microsoft Bookings
